rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for one measured portion of medicine taken at one time.

example.english: After taking one dose, my headache isn't as bad.
example.traditional: 食咗一劑藥之後，個頭冇咁痛喇。
example.jyutping: sik6 zo2 jat1 zai6 joek6 zi1 hau6 go3 tau4 mou5 gam3 tung3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a good or substantial amount of an abstract thing, such as skepticism.

example.english: They have a large dose of skepticism about this plan.
example.traditional: 佢對呢個計劃抱有大量懷疑。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 bou6 jau5 daai6 loeng6 waai4 ji4

rows.note: Use this for the lengthy spell or substantial experience aspect of the sense.

example.english: This trip gave us a long dose of hardship.
example.traditional: 今次旅行，我哋真係捱咗一大輪苦。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 ngo5 dei6 zan1 hai6 ngaai4 zo2 jat1 daai6 leon4 fu2
